annotation.justification: The clause unambiguously requires that any frame type other than HEADERS received on the same stream after a HEADERS frame without the EHB flag must be treated as a stream error of type HTTP_INTERRUPTED_HEADERS. The context provided by the preceding clause clarifies that the rule applies to frames on the same stream, and the phrase "any other type of frame" is understood to mean "any frame type other than HEADERS". No alternative reasonable interpretation or missing constraint is evident.
